title: Benchmarks log a fourth straight weekly gain

timeline.title: Benchmarks log a fourth straight weekly gain
timeline.line: Already up for the week before Friday, the indices added more to close the week higher
more: Before Friday's open, Nifty was up 1.3% and Sensex 1.6% for the week
Banks set three record highs during the week

src.title: Sensex, Nifty do a seesaw on Friday morning: BSE benchmark index crashes 600+ points at open but regains all it
